title: plettkea macrophylla
intro: Plettkea macrophylla, commonly known as the alpine penny-cress, is a type of flowering plant in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Plettkea macrophylla include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
